details:
Friends of a Friends Only instance always appear to be private even if you are friend with the instance owner.
It looks fine on https://vrchat.com/home/.
If you send a Req Invite when you have this problem, the friend will see it, but he will not be able to Invite.

In Quest, this is a bigger problem because [“Invite me” does not work properly](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/no-longer-receiving-notifications-invites-or-friend-requests).
title: Friends of a Friends Only instance always appear to be private even if you are friend with the instance owner
